text: Carnap distinguished internal questions, asked within a linguistic framework, from ___ questions about whether to adopt the framework at all; the latter he regarded as merely practical, not factual.
explanation: For Carnap, internal questions have straightforward answers within a framework, whereas external questions about adopting the framework are pragmatic choices, not factual claims about reality. Quine rejected this internal/external boundary, which is why the distinction is central to their dispute.
